description: Offline-first Android reader for Marxist articles, publications, and e-books. Marxist Reader is an offline-first Android application designed for reading Marxist and leftist content, articles, and e-books with primary support for Tamil and secondary support for English content. Key Features: • Feed: Browse latest articles and publications. • Article Reader: Clean reading interface with categories, tags, read-time estimates, and Tamil font support. • EPUB Reader: Built-in e-book reader with custom typography, sepia/dark themes, and Text-to-Speech (TTS) support. • Offline Support: All content is cached locally using Room database; read saved articles anytime without network connectivity. • Background Sync: Automatic background synchronization powered by WorkManager. • Bookmarks & Saved Content: Save articles and books for offline access. • Multilingual UI: Toggle seamlessly between Tamil and English interfaces. Privacy & Open Source: • 100% Free and Open Source software under GPL-3.0. • No tracking, ads, or analytics data collection.
